title: monachosorum subdigitatum
intro: Monachosorum subdigitatum, commonly known as the "Fang Ji" or "Stephania plant", is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Menispermaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine for its potential health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions due to its anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Monachosorum subdigitatum are attributed to its ability to warm the body, relieve pain, and promote perspiration, making it useful in traditional Chinese medicine. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
